sights.name: Moraine Lake
sights.what: Glacier-fed lake in the Valley of the Ten Peaks, reached from Lake Louise by Parks Canada shuttle or commercial tour only.
sights.why_must_do: Most photographed lake in the Rockies; Rockpile viewpoint and canoes.
sights.booking_needed: Yes: Parks Canada shuttle (2026: opened 15 Apr 2026 8am MT, 40% of seats, rest released 48h ahead; ran 1 Jun-12 Oct 2026; adult 12.75, youth 4.00, +3.50 online fee). Private vehicles not allowed on Moraine Lake Road year-round.
sights.child_note: Flat lakeshore (1.3 km one way) and Rockpile (0.7 km loop) suit a 6 year old. Shuttle fare tiers for youth: GAP age bands not verified.

sights.name: Lake Louise
sights.what: Turquoise glacial lake below Victoria Glacier with a flat lakeshore trail.
sights.why_must_do: Iconic Rockies lake; lakeshore walk and Fairview Lookout.
sights.booking_needed: Parking at lake is pay/limited; Lakeshore shuttle ran 15 May-12 Oct 2026 via Park and Ride (reserve)
sights.child_note: Lakeshore trail 2.3 km one way is easy; stroller-capable surface not verified (GAP).

sights.name: Johnston Canyon
sights.what: Catwalk trail through a limestone canyon to Lower and Upper Falls.
sights.why_must_do: Easy catwalk walk with waterfalls; Ink Pots beyond.
sights.child_note: Lower Falls 1.1 km one way, 85 m: fine for a 6 year old; exposed catwalks, hold hands. 2026 pattern: Johnston Canyon Trail closed from 13 Oct 2026 for rock slope work, status for Sept 2029 is GAP.

sights.name: Peyto Lake Lookout
sights.what: Viewpoint over a bright blue wolf-head-shaped lake from Bow Summit.
sights.why_must_do: Best easy view on the Icefields Parkway.
sights.best_time: Morning, light is best before noon
sights.child_note: 0.6 km one way, 30 m gain; paved to lookout is GAP (not verified).

sights.name: Bow Lake
sights.what: Large lake on the Icefields Parkway below Crowfoot Glacier, trailhead for Bow Glacier Falls.
sights.why_must_do: Roadside lake, picnic, Num-Ti-Jah Lodge.
sights.child_note: Bow Glacier Falls trail 3.8 km one way, 95 m (too long for the little one, lakeside strolling is fine).

sights.name: Vermilion Lakes Drive
sights.what: Scenic drive and wetland lakes on the edge of Banff townsite facing Mount Rundle.
sights.why_must_do: Sunrise/sunset views and elk and bird watching.
sights.child_note: Short stops, flat. GAP: no official page fetched for this sight; description is general knowledge.

sights.name: Cave and Basin National Historic Site
sights.what: Birthplace of Canada's national park system with a warm mineral spring cave.
sights.why_must_do: History plus boardwalk walks to marsh.
sights.child_note: Good rainy-day child stop. GAP: no official page fetched for this sight; description is general knowledge.

sights.name: Banff Gondola (Sulphur Mountain)
sights.what: Gondola to the summit of Sulphur Mountain with boardwalk and viewing deck.
sights.why_must_do: Big views with almost no walking; replaces the 4.8 km one-way, 655 m Sulphur Mountain trail.
sights.booking_needed: Private operator, book ahead in Sept long weekend; GAP: price/hours not verified
sights.child_note: Height requirements: GAP. Private operator, not Parks Canada.

sights.name: Lake Minnewanka
sights.what: Largest lake in Banff National Park with a short Stewart Canyon trail and cruise.
sights.why_must_do: Easy lake walk, scenic cruise.
sights.child_note: Lake Minnewanka Trail to Stewart Canyon bridge is 1.6 km one way, 30 m. 2026: trail past Stewart Canyon bridge, Aylmer Pass and several campgrounds closed from 16 Sep until further notice; Aylmer trails have group restriction 10 Jul-15 Sep.

sights.name: Icefields Parkway (Hwy 93N) scenic drive
sights.what: 230 km scenic drive between Lake Louise and Jasper through the Banff and Jasper icefields.
sights.why_must_do: Spine of the trip, with Peyto, Bow Lake, Columbia Icefield, Athabasca and Sunwapta Falls.
sights.best_time: Early morning start, Sept snow possible at Bow Summit
sights.child_note: Long drive for a 6 year old, plan frequent stops. Gas stations limited: GAP not verified.

sights.name: Athabasca Glacier and Columbia Icefield
sights.what: Toe of the Athabasca Glacier and the Columbia Icefield, roadside viewing with a walk to the glacier toe.
sights.why_must_do: Walk to the toe of a glacier you can see from the road.
sights.booking_needed: Glacier Adventure tours are private operator, book ahead: GAP not verified
sights.child_note: Toe trail 1.8 km round trip, 60 m: feasible. Do not walk on the ice. Icefield Centre information desk closed per 2026 page.

sights.name: Sunwapta Falls
sights.what: Powerful waterfall on the Sunwapta River just off the Icefields Parkway.
sights.why_must_do: Easy roadside falls.
sights.child_note: Upper falls viewpoint is short and fenced; Lower Sunwapta Falls trail 2.6 km round trip, 87 m. Trailhead and picnic site open per 2026 page.

sights.name: Athabasca Falls
sights.what: Powerful falls and canyon on the Athabasca River.
sights.why_must_do: Very short walk, big water.
sights.child_note: 200 m walk, fenced viewpoints; hold hands near canyon edges. Day-use area open per 2026 page.

sights.name: Maligne Lake and Spirit Island
sights.what: Largest lake in Jasper, boat cruise to Spirit Island.
sights.why_must_do: One of the most photographed spots in the Rockies.
sights.best_time: Morning; Sept cruises run until end of season GAP
sights.booking_needed: Cruise is private operator, book ahead: GAP not verified
sights.child_note: Cruise requires little walking; life jackets for child supplied by operator: GAP. Maligne Road reopened 11 Oct 2024; trailhead, boathouse picnic site open per 2026 page; Spirit Island cruise not confirmed on the page.

sights.name: Maligne Canyon
sights.what: Deep limestone canyon with waterfalls and bridges near Jasper.
sights.why_must_do: Normally a top family walk.
sights.child_note: CLOSED 2026: Superintendent closure, no public access (2026-10-08 trail conditions) and 'closed until further notice' on the Across the River page. Status in Sept 2029 is GAP.

sights.name: Pyramid Lake
sights.what: Lake and island with the iconic Pyramid Mountain backdrop near Jasper townsite.
sights.why_must_do: Easy sunset spot, picnic, boat rental.
sights.child_note: Pyramid Bench trails reopened per 2026 page; trailhead open. Lake Annette Loop (2.4 km flat) is nearby.

sights.name: Jasper Townsite
sights.what: Mountain town and park base, rebuilt after the July 2024 wildfire.
sights.why_must_do: Town services, dining, base for Maligne and Icefields.
sights.booking_needed: Accommodation: book early for Sept long weekend
sights.child_note: Town stroll. Post-wildfire burn area safety guidance: see Parks Canada page.

sights.name: Miette Hot Springs
sights.what: Hot springs pools at the end of Miette Road east of Jasper.
sights.why_must_do: Soak after hiking; Sulphur Skyline trail nearby.
sights.child_note: Miette Hot Springs open per 2026 page. Water temperature for a 6 year old: GAP.

sights.name: Mount Edith Cavell and Cavell Meadows
sights.what: Cavell Road to Angel Glacier viewpoint and the Path of the Glacier.
sights.why_must_do: Glacier views.
sights.child_note: CLOSED 2026: Cavell Road and day-use area closed; trails 41 Path of the Glacier and 42 Cavell Meadows closed (debris flow risk). Sept 2029 status GAP.

sights.name: Emerald Lake
sights.what: Emerald-green lake with a flat 5.2 km shoreline loop and lodge.
sights.why_must_do: Easy flat loop, canoe rental.
sights.child_note: Emerald Lakeshore 5.2 km loop, minimal gain, muddy and rooty on east side.

sights.name: Takakkaw Falls
sights.what: 373 m waterfall at the end of Yoho Valley Road.
sights.why_must_do: Tallest falls on the trip, flat paved walk to base.
sights.best_time: Road open mid-June to mid-October; late-day cloud
sights.child_note: 0.9 km one way flat paved path. Yoho Valley Road switchbacks: trailers not allowed GAP.

sights.name: Natural Bridge
sights.what: Rock bridge carved by the Kicking Horse River, near the Emerald Lake road turnoff.
sights.why_must_do: Roadside quick stop.
sights.child_note: Almost no walking. Parking is about 4 km west of Field on Emerald Lake Road. Distance to bridge: GAP.

sights.name: Wapta Falls
sights.what: Broad 30 m waterfall on the Kicking Horse River.
sights.why_must_do: Easy forest walk to a large falls.
sights.best_time: Anytime; road closed late Oct to late May
sights.child_note: 2.2 km one way, 80 m gain: family-friendly per Parks Canada. Eastbound access only from the highway.

sights.name: Marble Canyon
sights.what: Narrow marble canyon with bridges and a rim walk.
sights.why_must_do: Short, easy, high impact.
sights.child_note: 0.9 km one way, 65 m. Fenced bridges.

sights.name: Paint Pots
sights.what: Three iron-rich mineral springs staining ochre ground.
sights.why_must_do: Easy flat walk; Indigenous cultural site.
sights.child_note: 1 km one way, 35 m. Good for 6 year old.

sights.name: Radium Hot Springs
sights.what: Hot mineral pools at the park's west gate in Sinclair Canyon.
sights.why_must_do: Soak and swim break.
sights.child_note: Pool depth/age rules: GAP. 2026 note: Hot Springs trail connector to Sinclair Canyon closed for road construction.

sights.name: Waterton Townsite
sights.what: Lakeside village in Waterton Lakes National Park with shoreline cruise and Bear's Hump trail.
sights.why_must_do: Compact base; wildlife and prairie-meets-mountain scenery.
sights.child_note: Town shoreline paths flat. Wildlife corridor caution on Entrance Road per 2026 notice.

sights.name: Red Rock Parkway and Red Rock Canyon
sights.what: 15 km scenic drive to Red Rock Canyon with a short loop and Blakiston Falls.
sights.why_must_do: Easy red argillite canyon walk.
sights.best_time: Open until October; closed to motor vehicles Oct-May
sights.child_note: Red Rock Canyon Loop open per 2026 page. Loop length: GAP, INFERENCE 0.7 km.

sights.name: Cameron Lake
sights.what: Subalpine lake at the end of Akamina Parkway on the Continental Divide.
sights.why_must_do: Boat rental, grizzly habitat, flat shore walk.
sights.child_note: Cameron Lakeshore Trail listed open (2026-10-12). Bear warning: GAP no specific warning listed for it.

sights.name: Prince of Wales Hotel
sights.what: Historic 1927 hotel on a bluff with a view of Upper Waterton Lake.
sights.why_must_do: Classic photo; afternoon tea.
sights.child_note: Prince of Wales Loop Trail open per 2026 page.

trails.name: Larch Valley to Sentinel Pass
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Moraine Lake shuttle required (Parks Canada shuttle, reserve; see moraine-lake sight)
trails.child_note: Too long and steep for a 6 year old (11.2 km return, 750 m).
trails.less_walking_alternative: Moraine Lake canoe or Rockpile viewpoint
trails.sept_notes: Larches turn late Sept (blog: peak about 20-30 Sept, so early Sept is usually too early, green); snow possible above treeline any time. Trail listed with no closure on Parks Canada page.
trails.hazards: Grizzly and black bear country; carry bear spray, group travel recommended. Group-of-four restriction for Larch Valley area in late summer: GAP (official Moraine Lake page returned 404), INFERENCE only.

trails.name: Plain of Six Glaciers (to teahouse and Abbot Pass viewpoint)
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Lake Louise paid parking or Lakeshore shuttle (reserve)
trails.child_note: 11.8 km return, 595 m: too long for a 6 year old. Teahouse figure used is Parks Canada's 5.9 km one way. Abbot Pass hut climb is mountaineering, beyond the trail viewpoint (GAP).
trails.sept_notes: Teahouse open in summer: operating dates GAP. Snow possible.
trails.hazards: Avalanche debris and exposed sections near end: GAP.

trails.name: Lake Agnes Tea House
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Lake Louise paid parking or Lakeshore shuttle (reserve)
trails.child_note: 3.9 km one way, 495 m: steady switchbacks; a fit 6 year old may manage but it is long. Classified adult_only for safety.
trails.less_walking_alternative: Lake Louise canoe or lakeshore walk
trails.sept_notes: Tea house closes at end of season: date GAP.

trails.name: Iceline Trail
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Yoho Valley Road open mid-June to mid-Oct; parking lot at falls
trails.child_note: 20 km, 1090 m: not for a 6 year old.
trails.sept_notes: Trail conditions Fair on 2026-10-05, deadfall, snow at high elevation. Parks Canada gives other figures (20.8 km/710 m; Celeste Lake bypass 17.4 km/970 m).

trails.name: Emerald Triangle (via Wapta Highline)
trails.sept_notes: GAP: user listed Highline Trail; this is the Yoho Wapta Highline route. The Glacier Park/Jasper Highline is not covered.

trails.name: Sunshine Meadows to Citadel Pass
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Sunshine Village gondola/shuttle: GAP schedule not verified
trails.child_note: Parks Canada lists Sunshine Meadows 10.2 km, 580 m; Citadel Pass add-on is GAP.
trails.less_walking_alternative: Sunshine gondola and short meadow stroll
trails.sept_notes: Larches in Sunshine area typically turn late Sept: INFERENCE. Shuttle season end GAP.

trails.name: Crypt Lake
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Boat shuttle required, book ahead (Waterton Shoreline Cruise Co.)
trails.child_note: Includes a tunnel and narrow ledge: Parks Canada difficult. Not for a 6 year old.
trails.sept_notes: 2026-10-12: Crypt Lake Trail 'Not recommended' because no boat shuttle access. Cruises run late May to Sept (guide, not official). Wishbone Trail to Crypt Landing overgrown.

trails.name: Bear's Hump
trails.child_note: Short but steep with drop offs; ability varies.

trails.name: Skyline Trail
trails.sept_notes: Snow in the Notch can last to mid-July. Open but challenging 2026-10-08. Gain GAP.

trails.name: Opal Hills Loop
trails.sept_notes: CLOSED 2026-10-08 due to grizzly bear activity.

trails.name: Wilcox Pass
trails.child_note: First viewpoint is 2.4 km; full 8 km is long.

trails.name: Parker Ridge
trails.child_note: 5.4 km, 250 m: a fit 6 year old could try.

trails.name: Fryatt Valley
trails.sept_notes: Not closed 2026-10-06, Fryatt Lake to ACC hut difficult.

trails.name: Moraine Lakeshore
trails.parking_or_shuttle: Moraine Lake shuttle required (Parks Canada shuttle, reserve; see moraine-lake sight)

trails.name: Lake Louise Lakeshore
trails.child_note: 2.3 km one way, listed gain 175 m (GAP confidence; verify).

trails.name: Emerald Lakeshore
trails.child_note: Flat; 5.2 km loop slightly over 5 km.
